title: The Vanishing Lighthouse of Eilean Mor
hook: In December 1900, an entire crew vanished from a remote Scottish lighthouse without a trace, leaving their meals half-eaten.

scenes.narration: On a desolate island off the coast of Scotland, three experienced keepers tended the light. But on a cold winter night, they disappeared entirely.
scenes.visual_prompt: An eerie old lighthouse on a dark stormy cliff overlooking rough ocean waves.

scenes.narration: When a relief ship finally docked, they found the doors unlocked, the clocks stopped, and chairs overturned, as if everyone vanished mid-sentence.
scenes.visual_prompt: A dusty, abandoned lighthouse kitchen with a half-eaten meal on the wooden table.
